projects.title: uPVC Mullion Cutting Machine
projects.summary: Reverse-engineered an existing industrial mullion-cutting machine, documented its mechanical structure, and recreated the components and assembly in CATIA V5.

projects.title: Robotic Nail-Punching End Effector
projects.summary: Designed a custom aluminum holder in CATIA V5 to mount a nail-gun end effector to a robot wrist, as part of a collaborative robotics simulation project.

projects.title: Vehicle Cruise & Adaptive Control
projects.summary: Built and evaluated vehicle speed and distance-control models using PI/PID feedback, anti-windup, robustness checks and observer-based control.

projects.title: BMW 730 Steering Dynamics
projects.summary: Analyzed a BMW 730 lateral model and designed active yaw-rate control with state-estimation comparisons involving Luenberger and Wiener/Kalman approaches.

projects.title: Inverted Pendulum Stabilization
projects.summary: Stabilized a simulated unstable cart–pendulum system using state feedback, pole placement, LQR and integral action for cart-position tracking.

projects.title: Closed-Loop DC–DC Buck Converter
projects.summary: Modeled a buck converter and cascaded voltage/current regulation in MATLAB/Simulink across input-voltage and load variations.

projects.title: Moss Detection on Building Walls
projects.summary: Compared classical contour-based segmentation with DeepLabv3+ / ResNet-50 for detecting moss on textured wall images.

projects.title: Bicycle Dynamics & Feedback Control
projects.summary: Studied bicycle stability using dynamic models, root-locus analysis and feedback control of the Whipple bicycle model.

projects.title: Kalman Filtering for Motion Tracking
projects.summary: Implemented a Kalman-filter-based tracking method for noisy simulated observations of a football during penalty-kick trajectories.

projects.title: Rolling-Bearing Fault Diagnostics
projects.summary: Investigated rolling-bearing fault classification by combining vibration analysis, thermal imagery, signal processing and SVM techniques.
